description: Convert between an hourly pay rate and an annual salary based on hours worked per week (52 weeks a year). Mode 'to_salary' turns an hourly rate into annual, monthly and weekly pay; mode 'to_hourly' turns a salary into an hourly rate. Gross amounts in GBP, before tax. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/hourly-to-salary/

hourlyRate.description: Hourly pay rate in GBP (required for to_salary)

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours worked per week (greater than 0, up to 168)

mode.description: 'to_salary' from an hourly rate, or 'to_hourly' from a salary

salary.description: Annual salary in GBP (required for to_hourly)

name: hopi_hourly_to_salary

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Hourly wage to salary converter
